        <div class="headline">
          
          <h1 class="hdln-240 hdln-eb spanned"><span>Hvide</span> <span>Sande</span></h1> 
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="top-line"></div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="background"><img src="https://www.drivethru.de/content/uploads/2024/12/drivethru_cr_kanngutwerden_241202_website-1-2560x1440.jpg?x47806" style="aspect-ratio: 2560 / 1440;" alt="" loading="eager" width="2560" height="1440" data-orientation="landscape" fetchpriority="high" /></div>
  </div>
        
  <div class="module module-copy mrgn-33" data-dynamic-background-color="#ffffff">
    <div class="module-inner">
      <div class="module-wrap"> 
        <div class="wysiwyg cpy-24">
          <h2 class="headline hdln-62">Drivethru Kite &amp; Surf Camp – Your Home for a Week!</h2>
<p>Looking for waves, wind, and a place to unwind? Drivethru Kite &amp; Surf Camp Hvide Sande is the sport for you. Tucked away on Denmark’s west coast, between the wild North Sea and the Ringkøbing Fjord, our camp offers everything you need for an epic getaway.</p>
<p>We’ve got a huge 35,000 m² garden with a sauna, hot tub, and plenty of room to relax. Just a short 900 m walk through the dunes leads you to your first surf spot, and our private fjord access is perfect for kitesurfing. When you’re not on the water, join a movement class or treat yourself to a massage.</p>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
        
  <div class="module module-two-images mrgn-100" data-dynamic-background-color="#ffffff">

      <div class="module-wrap"> 
        <div class="wysiwyg cpy-24">
          <h4 class="subsubheadline hdln-40 hdln-sb">What’s included?</h4>
<p>Breakfast, lunch snack, and dinner<br />
Access to kayaks, SUPs, bikes, surfboards, sauna and hot tub<br />
Surf, kitesurf, and yoga sessions designed for all levels</p>
<h4 class="subsubheadline hdln-40 hdln-sb">Our Highlights:</h4>
<ul>
<li>Rooms with Fjord view</li>
<li>Homemade food</li>
<li>Private kite spot</li>
<li>Sauna &amp; Hot Tub</li>
<li>35,000 m² garden</li>
<li>Beginner-friendly</li>
<li>Empty beaches &amp; lineups</li>
<li>Massages</li>
<li>Workout Room</li>
<li>Guest Kitchen</li>
<li>Eco- and pet-friendly</li>
</ul>
<p>Choose one of our packages for the perfect vacation at our drivethru Kite &amp; Surfcamp Denmark<br />
Whether it’s surfing, kitesurfing, yoga, or a mix of all three, we’ve got the perfect package waiting for you.<br />
Let’s make it happen! <a href="https://bookings.drivethru.de/en/category/surf-kite-camp-hvide-sande">Book here</a>.</p>

            <div class="col-1">
              <div class="package-description">
                <div class="wysiwyg cpy-22">
                  <p>Jump into the New Year in idyllic Denmark. The Danish tradition is to jump from a chair into the new year. For your New Year’s special, we combine the tradition with relaxing activities to give you a little time out, but also have a good time to start the new year with full energy. Enjoy our barrel sauna in the cold temperatures and/or enjoy a hot punch at the hot tub. But also long winter walks on the beach and through the dunes, lets the head once again become free. Of course, a rich dinner, as well as a large and long breakfast awaits you in the new year.</p>

                </div>
                
                <div class="price hdln-46">
                  From 399,-€ / 3 Nights in a 4-bed dorm
                </div>

            <div class="col-1">
              <div class="package-description">
                <div class="wysiwyg cpy-22">
                  <p>We will get you on the board! Choose between kite lessons, supervised kiting, or equipment rental. Our Kite lessons at drivethru Kite &amp; Surf Camp Hvide Sande are in small groups at our private fjord spot, perfect for all wind directions. With safety as our top priority, our instructors provide personalized coaching and use well-maintained gear.</p>
<p>After your session, relax in the sauna and enjoy a homemade dinner while connecting with fellow surfers. Whether you’re a beginner or refining your skills, our kitesurfing camp guarantees an unforgettable experience!</p>

                </div>
                
                <div class="price hdln-46">
                  From 1190,-€ / 7 days in a 4 Person Dorm
                </div>
                
              </div>

<p>Beyond surfing, our camp is all about community. Connect with fellow surf enthusiasts and enjoy evenings around the bonfire while the sun sets over the ocean.<br />
Whether you’re chasing your first wave or perfecting your technique, Drivethru Surf Camp ensures a rewarding experience, no matter the weather.</p>
